units: all x,y,bbox,pts in frame fractions of 1376x768; r = fraction of frame HEIGHT; pivot = fraction of the layer box; amp = max sideways displacement of the layer top as fraction of layer height (~radians of bend); speed = cycles/second
draw_order: plate (or plate_clean) -> beam/disc/shimmer/flicker fx -> sway layers -> figures -> particles(front ones) -> dormouse -> caption

sway.name: curtain
sway.motion: bend: horizontal shift grows with distance from pivot (top moves, pivot row fixed)
sway.note: cloth hanging from the rod: top fixed, hem drifts in the draught from the door

flicker.note: oil-lamp flame; also brighten wall glow

beam.note: cool daylight from the door; dust motes drift slowly inside

particles.note: inside door beam only, slow drift
rare tiny white puffs near the trough, optional

dormouse.note: y = feet contact; 'facing' applies to the segment that starts at that point
